class.name: ARAnchorTracker
class.brief_description: Game-created world anchor applied with the camera packet being drawn.
class.description: Trackers have type XRServer.TRACKER_ANCHOR and names pocketar/anchor/<generation>/<id>. The inherited default pose is valid in [constant TRACKING], with high confidence and zero velocities. [constant PAUSED] retains the last transform with an invalid pose; [constant STOPPED] is terminal. Android hit creation attaches to the native plane through ArTrackable_acquireNewAnchor; free creation uses ArSession_acquireNewAnchor. iOS creates an ordinary ARAnchor at the requested pose for either method. Call ARView.remove_anchor(anchor) to unregister and release native ownership. See the [url=https://github.com/doublesymmetry/pocketar/blob/main/docs/api.md#anchors]anchor contract[/url] for creation freshness, scene nodes and lifecycle.

members.member: Opaque identity, never reused within [member session_generation].
Owning session generation. A generation change permanently stops old anchors.
Originally requested plane ID, including when creation resolves a subsumed replacement; zero for free creation. Negative IDs come from debug-plane hits.
Current [enum TrackingState]. Lifecycle invalidation is immediate even without a new camera packet.
Requested world-from-anchor pose at creation, then the last usable applied pose. Preserved while paused/stopped but invalid for new interactions in those states.

signal.name: tracking_state_changed
signal.description: Deferred notification coalesced to the latest state. Inherited pose signals and XRAnchor3D.tracking_changed remain synchronous. ARView.anchors_changed reports deferred membership changes; use ARView.packet_applied for a matching camera/anchor pair.

constants.constant: The applied camera packet contains a usable anchor pose.
The anchor retains identity and its last transform but has no usable pose. Includes accepted creations awaiting their first eligible packet.
The anchor is permanently stopped, unregistered and released from native ownership.
